narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved across parts of northern Illinois during the afternoon of May 7th producing large hail, localized flooding and one tornado. Additional scattered thunderstorms developed during the evening of May 7th producing locally severe winds.
ev: Traffic cameras showed all lanes of northbound Interstate 57 flooded between Halsted Street and Wentworth Avenue.
